blocks.prompt: 5 What are the dimensions of the smallest rectangle aligned to the axes that completely contains the ellipse \(\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{9} = 1\)?
blocks.explanation:
Sawal yeh hai ke ellipse ko poora andar rakhne wala sab se chhota rectangle kitna bara hoga, jis ki sides axes ke parallel hon.
Is ke liye dekhna hai ke ellipse left-right aur upar-neeche kahan tak phaila hua hai.
Equation mein do non-negative (kabhi negative na hone wale) terms ka jama 1 hai, is liye har term zyada se zyada 1 ho sakta hai. Isi se \(x\) aur \(y\) ki hadd (limit) milegi.
Socho jaise ek anda dabbe (box) mein band karna ho: dabba utna hi bara chahiye jitna anda sab se lamba aur sab se chaura hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\frac{x^2}{16} + \frac{y^2}{9} = 1\), yani \(a = 4\), \(b = 3\).
Maloom karna: axes ke parallel sab se chhota rectangle jo ellipse ko poora gher le.
Tareeqa: dono terms non-negative hain aur jama 1 hai, is liye har term 1 se zyada nahi ho sakta.

Ellipse kahan tak phaila hai
\[\frac{x^2}{16} \le 1 \Rightarrow -4 \le x \le 4\]
\[\frac{y^2}{9} \le 1 \Rightarrow -3 \le y \le 3\]
Kyun: \(\frac{y^2}{9} \ge 0\), is liye \(\frac{x^2}{16}\) zyada se zyada 1; isi tarah doosra. \(x^2 \le 16\) ka matlab \(-4 \le x \le 4\).

Rectangle
Poora ellipse \(x = \pm 4\) aur \(y = \pm 3\) wale rectangle ke andar hai.
\[\text{width} = 4 - (-4) = 8, \quad \text{height} = 3 - (-3) = 6\]
Kyun: yahi upar wali hadd hain.

Is se chhota nahi ho sakta
Ellipse in chaaron lines ko vertices \((\pm 4, 0)\) aur co-vertices \((0, \pm 3)\) par chhoota hai. Jo rectangle ellipse ko gher le, usay yeh chaar points bhi gherne honge, is liye width kam az kam 8 aur height kam az kam 6.
Kyun: koi side chhoti karein to koi vertex ya co-vertex bahar reh jayega.
Dhyan dein: jawab 4 by 3 nahi; 4 aur 3 to semi-axes hain, poori lambaiyan 8 aur 6 hain.

Ek nazar mein
Is sawal ka sabaq yeh hai ke ellipse ki equation khud batati hai ke \(x\) aur \(y\) kahan tak ja sakte hain: \(|x| \le a\) aur \(|y| \le b\).

Tasdeeq
Width \(= 2a\) (major axis) aur height \(= 2b\) (minor axis). Area \(8 \times 6 = 48\) square units.
Kyun: yani yeh rectangle bilkul major aur minor axis ke barabar hai, jo samajh mein aata hai.
blocks.final_answer: 8 units by 6 units (the rectangle with sides \(x = \pm 4\) and \(y = \pm 3\))

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key Exercise 6.4 ke 13 sawalon ke jawab 1 se 16 tak number karti hai, is liye number nahi milte. Is sawal ka jawab key 9 par chhapa hai. Keys 6, 7 aur 8 kisi chhape hue sawal ke nahi.
